summary: Frontend e2e testing of the 3 new features (Tags, Cards, Subscriptions) + light regression. All features work end-to-end. Created a Tag (with reward), viewed detail (QR canvas visible, copy/download/open-public visible), toggled lost mode (button switches to btn-danger). Visited public /t/:qrId - all 5 alert buttons visible, tag-alert-found produced tag-scan-success. Created a Card with full contact info, opened detail (QR + public link), visited /c/:qrId which shows public name, call/mail/web tiles, save-contact vCard link pointing to /api/public/card/{qr}/vcf?dl=1, and card message form successfully posted showing card-message-sent. Subscription page: demo_web already active on family_pro (banner shown, subscribe-family_pro disabled 'Current plan'). Registered a fresh user and subscribed to basic - dry-run auto-confirmed, sub-notice shown ('Subscription activated (Stripe test mode / DRY-RUN).'), current-sub-banner appeared, subscribe-basic became 'Current plan' disabled. Regression: landing, login, register, dashboard, alerts, tags, cards pages all load; admin login + /admin admin-page visible. TopNav shows Vehicles/Tags/Cards/Alerts/Plans links.
critical_code_review_comments: Login/Register buttons rely on implicit form submit (no explicit type='submit'). data-testid selectors work fine; note for future test authors.
test_credentials: demo_web@safeqr.com / demo1234 ; admin@safeqr.com / admin1234 ; fresh test user created during run
seed_data_creation: Created 1 Tag and 1 Card under demo_web, plus 1 new user with basic subscription (dry-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (Tags, Cards, Subscriptions dry-run) fully functional via UI. Public tag/card pages, vCard link, subscription dry-run confirm all working. Rate limits observed - test hit tag-alert-found once, card-message once. If retesting subscriptions on demo_web, note it is now on family_pro; use a fresh user for a clean subscribe flow.
